audit.why: Favoured 4/10 fits 52.01% over 771 games, and both layers already agree on the chart (Irelia all seven rows). Verdict untouched; the templated prose beneath it was grounded in Aurora's actual cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose referred to a 'spirit-swap' and to an ultimate that vaguely 'adds mobility/peel', with no numbers anywhere (packet: zero sequencing cues, no ability named).
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18 — a leap into stealth, her only real exit. Between Worlds is 140/120/100 at 250 range: a leap, a shockwave slow, then a zone she can teleport across.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = a 140s leap plus a crossable slow zone. Your all-in window is the 22s her leap is down.
sources: enemyKit W/R text, cd and range

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things: the page repeatedly calls Flawless Duet a root, and it never states the interaction that decides the lane — Irelia's E grounds dashes, and both Across the Veil and Between Worlds are dashes.
audit.why: ownerKit E text says enemies caught between the blades are 'damaged, stunned and Marked'; the flags list grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes') and hardCC. enemyKit W and R both carry the dash flag.
audit.corrected: One landed stun takes both her exits away. It is a stun, not a root.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint) and the packet reports no 'wait for X before you Y' line anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Across the Veil 22s at rank 1, Twofold Hex 9s at 900 with a recast that drags the curse back, The Weirding 15s, Between Worlds 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: All four written in, plus sequencing in dosFull and content early/mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Spirit Abjuration healing her off every trade.
audit.why: enemyKit P: exorcised spirits follow Aurora and heal her; missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named in 'ahead' and content 'early'.
sources: enemyKit P text and heal flag

edits.after: Across the Veil is a 22s leap into stealth — Flawless Duet grounds it, so stun her before she jumps, not after.

edits.after: Aurora wins by curing chip damage with her spirits, poking at 900 with Twofold Hex, and leaping out of your stun.

edits.before: - Aurora Across the Veil (Hop): matchup-defining — Her hop + stealth escape — she is killable only while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Defiant Dance for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
